prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-quality preview of Fonte product rack in a hypermarket for a corporate Sales page.
EDIT TARGET: image 1 is the FIRST rack draft approved for composition: four shelf levels, centered full-width dark metal and pale wood rack, bread top row, buns second, tortillas/cupcakes third, tomato paste and breadcrumbs bottom, cart at lower right. Work from image 1, not the later five-level draft. Preserve its composition, camera, crop, scene, rack, merchandise arrangement and lighting.
AUTHORITATIVE IDENTITY REFERENCES: image 2 is the user's correct real Fonte tomato paste retail carton. It overrides ALL earlier tomato paste designs. Image 3 is the original real product-range catalogue photo for bread/tortillas/cupcakes and their actual package colors/artwork. Image 4 is the original real bun bag photo. Image 5 is the original real breadcrumb box photo. Use only the actual printed packaging as references; ignore every external advertising headline, watermark, background, props and overlay in images 3–5.
PRIMARY REQUIRED FIX: replace EVERY tomato paste carton on the lower-left shelf with the EXACT carton design from image 2: cream/white upper panel, actual red-and-gold Fonte logo at top, narrow green curved dividing band, red lower body with warm orange/yellow glow, exact Arabic product title معجون الطماطم and طبيعي, large real tomato graphic and a small white bowl of red paste at the bottom. Match the original carton top flap and side-panel design where visible. No invented all-red substitute, no English product-name line that is absent from the actual pack, no logo modernization or changed fonts, artwork, branding or colors.
CRITICAL SIZE REQUIREMENT: all tomato paste cartons must be one identical retail SKU and exactly the same physical height, width and depth. Align all front faces on one plane with tops at the same level and bottoms resting on the same shelf. Remove the undersized/mismatched cartons at the right end of the current tomato paste row. Use eight equal-size cartons across the same tomato paste shelf area if necessary, rather than distorting proportions or squeezing smaller boxes into a gap. Duplicate the same exact reference carton artwork consistently on every unit. Respect physical perspective, contact shadows and realistic normal retail proportions relative to nearby breadcrumb boxes.
OTHER PRODUCT CONSISTENCY: compare the packages in image 1 to the authoritative original images 3–5. Retain the red Fonte shield, gold border, correct bilingual Fonte/فونتي logo lettering, product variant colors, printed product photographs, bag/box shapes and typography. Correct any noticeable identity drift to the actual references. Brown sliced bread orange/gold, white sliced bread red/yellow, bran sliced bread green/yellow; match the original tortilla flavor colors and artwork. Keep the bun packs transparent with the actual red/blue sesame burger bun design and the breadcrumb boxes red/gold as in reference. Never invent new variants, spellings, logos, decorative details or package layouts. Preserve all existing categories and positions. No extra products or fifth shelf.
QUALITY: render a crisp, naturally photorealistic commercial photograph at the highest native detail available, preferably 3072x2048 landscape. Clean sharp packaging fronts without oversharpened halos, realistic transparent plastic reflections, natural ambient hypermarket lighting and subtle background blur. Keep the rack itself sharp and exactly centered. Preserve the background, shelf material colors and cart. No new signage, captions, prices, promotional overlays, watermarks, or Masdar branding. Do not copy the white background of image 2 into the scene. No CGI look. Product identity fidelity is more important than adding new visual decoration.
source: Approved rack preview with corrected tomato paste packaging
